Requirement Description: The system shall allow a new user to register with a unique email address and a password of at least 8 characters.
The system shall reject registration when the email address is already in use and display an error message.
The system shall allow users to search the catalogue by title, author, or ISBN and return matching results within 2 seconds.
The system shall display "No results found" when a search returns no matches.
A registered user shall be able to borrow up to 3 available books at a time for a 14-day loan period.
The system shall prevent borrowing when the user already has 3 books on loan or an overdue item.
The system shall record a return, update book availability, and calculate any overdue fine at P2.00 per day.
The system shall email the user 2 days before the due date and again on each day the book is overdue.
